title: Book a motorcycle rider training course
summary: Find information and book a training course to obtain a learner or provisional motorcycle rider licence.
intro:
To obtain either a learner or provisional motorcycle rider licence, you need to attend and pass the training course relevant to your licence.

Pre-learner and pre-provisional rider training is available at approved rider training centres for applicants living in a serviced area.

There is now a trike-only training and testing pathway for customers to get a licence to ride a trike. For further information, visit Riding a trike on NSW Roads.

Note: Visit a service centre if a rider training centre is unavailable in your local area.
who_can_apply: Must be 16 years and 6 months old to attend a pre-learner course.
Must be at least 16 years and 9 months old to get a learner rider licence.
Must have held a learner rider licence for at least 3 months.
Must book the course within 6 weeks before the end of the 3-month qualifying period.
Must complete the course before the expiry of the learner rider licence.
what_you_need: Your driver licence, Photo Card, or Transport for NSW customer number.

how_to_steps.text: Select the 'Find a rider training provider' button.
Visit their website and book your course.

more_info.text: Make sure you've booked your pre-provisional training at least 4 to 6 weeks before your learner licence expires. This will give you enough time to reschedule another test if you fail, or have to delay, the first one.
If you do not pass the provisional training before your licence expires, you'll have to start the entire program again – this includes paying the fees again.
You cannot get an extension or renewal of a learner rider licence.

faqs.q: How do I start the process of getting a motorcycle licence?
faqs.a: To get a learner or provisional motorcycle rider licence, you must attend and pass the relevant training course.

faqs.q: What is the minimum age to start training for a learner licence?
faqs.a: You can attend a pre-learner course when you are 16 years and 6 months old. To get your learner rider licence, you must be at least 16 years and 9 months old.

faqs.q: Do I need to visit a service centre?
faqs.a: Visit a service centre if a rider training centre is unavailable in your local area.
